records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese: …はい、これが今回の分よ
records.current_English:
...Here you go.
 This is the latest batch.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ありがとう
ところで…ねえ、シャルロット
君に渡したいものがあるんだけど…
records.current_English:
Thanks. Charlotte... 
 I've got something for you.

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese: なあに？
records.current_English: What?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
これ…トウモロコシの種なんだ
君たちの村の新しい交易品に
できるかもしれないと思って
records.current_English:
These are corn seeds.
 I thought corn might give
 the village something new to sell.

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
まあ…そんな
FIには
いつも親切にしてもらってばかりで
あたし…
records.current_English:
Oh... FI, 
 you're always helping me... I...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
い、いや、そんな気にしなくていいよ
特産物が増えたら、僕たちも
助かるし…
records.current_English:
N-no, think nothing of it. More
 goods for the village to trade 
 would help us, too...

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
…そうね。ありがとう
みんなも喜ぶわ
records.current_English:
...You're right. Thank you.
 Everyone will be so happy.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
よかった！
…だけど、荷物が多くて大変そうだね
records.current_English: Good! But that load looks heavy.

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
平気よ
あたし、いつも農作業で鍛えているから
records.current_English:
I'm fine. Working the fields 
 keeps me strong.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: でも…
records.current_English: But...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
FI
送ってやれよ！
records.current_English: FI, walk her back!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: え？
records.current_English: Huh?

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
そんな、悪いわ
本当に平気よ、ほらっ
records.current_English:
Oh, I couldn't ask you to do that. 
 I'm really fine. Look!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
まあ、まあ、いいって、いいって
俺に貸してみな
records.current_English: Come on! Hand that over.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
とりあえず半分にしてっと
FIのを
ちょっと重くして…
records.current_English:
Let's split it in half... and make 
 FI's half 
 a little heavier...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
ほらよ、出来たぜ！
はい、これ持って
records.current_English: There! Take this.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
わわ！
ちょっと、クラウ！
records.current_English: Whoa! Clau!

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
ごめんなさい…
重いでしょ？
records.current_English: Sorry... Heavy, isn't it?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
えっ？
いや、全然！！
records.current_English: What? Not at all!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
じゃあ、ちょっと行って来るね
クラウ、あとのことは…
records.current_English:
I'll be back shortly. Clau,
 can you take care of the rest...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
任せとけって！
さあさ、行った、行った！！！
records.current_English: Leave it to me! Now get going!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
…
ふー。やれやれだぜ
records.current_English: Whew. What a pair.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
まったく、ツメが甘いんだよ
…やっぱ、FIには
俺がついててやんねえと、な
records.current_English:
He never follows through, does he? 
 Good thing FI has me
 looking out for him!

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
どうぞ
今、お茶でも入れるわ！
records.current_English: Come in. I'll make some tea!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うん
records.current_English: All right.

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
あ…
ごめんなさい…
びっくりしてるのね
records.current_English:
Oh... I'm sorry... 
 You must be surprised.

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
ふふっ、何もないでしょう？
家と言っても、かろうじて屋根と壁が
あるってだけだものね
records.current_English:
Heh... Not much here, is there?
 It's barely a house. Just
 a roof and some walls.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: …シャルロットはいつからここに？
records.current_English: When did you arrive, Charlotte?

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
ヨーロッパを出たのが１１のとき
だから…今から６年前かしら
はい、どうぞ
records.current_English:
I was eleven when we left Europe.
 That would be six years ago. 
 Here you go.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ありがとう
ん？　６年前で１１歳ということは…
records.current_English:
Thanks. Wait, if you were eleven 
 six years ago...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
１７？
それじゃあ、シャルロットって
僕と同い年だったんだ！？
records.current_English:
You're seventeen? Charlotte, 
 we're the same age?!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: てっきり年上だと…あっ
records.current_English: I thought you were older... Oh!

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
意外？
そうね。あたし、肌はがさがさだし
手だってこんなに…
records.current_English:
Surprised? My skin is rough, 
 and look at my hands...

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
とても同年代の…
年頃の女の子とは思えないわね
records.current_English:
I hardly seem like... like other 
 girls my age, do I?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そんなことないよ！　シャルロットって
すごくしっかりしてるから、何となく
そう思いこんでいただけで…
records.current_English:
Not at all! You're 
 so good at handling things, I just 
 assumed you were older...

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
…FIは
とってもきれいね
まるで女の子みたい…
records.current_English:
FI, you're so pretty. 
 Almost like a girl...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
お、女の子！？
…そんなに頼りないかな？
records.current_English:
A-a girl?! Do I really look like 
 I can't handle myself?

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
あ、そういう意味じゃないの
そうじゃなくて
きっとあなたの横には…
records.current_English:
No, that's not what I meant. I just
 meant the person beside you must...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: シャルロット？
records.current_English: Charlotte?

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
ううん、なんでもない…
まあっ、たいへん！
もう日が暮れてきちゃうわ
records.current_English:
Oh, never mind... Oh no, it's
 getting dark already!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ホントだ！
早く帰らなくっちゃ
records.current_English: Right! Better hurry home.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: それじゃあ…
records.current_English: Well then...

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
あっ、FI！
ちょっと待ってて！
records.current_English: Oh, FI! Wait here a moment!

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
お待たせ
これ…
records.current_English: Sorry to keep you waiting. Here...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
わあっ、かわいい花だね
この花を僕に？
records.current_English:
Oh, what a pretty flower!
 Is this for me?

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
（こくんっ）
今日のお礼
…こんなものしかないんだけど
records.current_English:
(Nods) To thank you for today. 
 It's all I've got.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ありがとう、シャルロット！
すっごくうれしいよ
records.current_English: Thank you, Charlotte! I love it!

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese:
次に来てくれるときまでに
もらった種が大きく育ってると
いいわね
records.current_English:
I hope the seeds you gave us 
 have sprouted and grown
 by the next time you come.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うん、楽しみにしてるよ！
じゃあ、また
records.current_English:
I'm looking forward to it! 
 See you, then.

records.speaker: Charlotte Miller
records.Japanese: ええ、さよなら
records.current_English: Yes. Goodbye.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
おっ、アルカディウス
FI
見なかったか？
records.current_English: Hey, Arcadius. Seen FI?

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese:
あら、クラウ
FIなら
さっき帰ってきて
花に水をあげてましたよ
records.current_English:
Oh, Clau. FI
 just came back 
 and was watering his flower.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.current_English: A flooower?

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese:
ええ。花瓶が欲しいというので
届けに行ったら
ニコニコしながら花を眺めて…
records.current_English:
Yes. He asked for a vase.
 When I brought it, he just sat 
 there smiling at the flower...

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese: 何かいいことでもあったのかしらね
records.current_English: Perhaps something nice happened.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: ふ～ん、さては…
records.current_English: Hmm. Maybe...

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese: …何か知ってるんですね、クラウ
records.current_English: You know something, Clau.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: お、おう。ちょっとな
records.current_English: W-well, a little.

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese:
ずるいですよ
１人で楽しんでないで教えて！
きっと、この前のあの子のことですね
records.current_English:
That's unfair! 
 Don't keep it to yourself. It's
 about the girl from before,
 isn't it?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
へへっ
実は…
records.current_English: Heh. Well...

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese:
なるほど
ふふふ、この村の発展もそうですけど
この先の楽しみが増えましたね
records.current_English:
I see. Hee hee.
 The village is coming along, 
 and now we have something else 
 to look forward to.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: おうよ
records.current_English: Yep.

rows: so good at handling things, I just
Oh, never mind... Oh no, it's
Don't keep it to yourself. It's

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: これが、世界の東の果ての風景か…
records.current_English:
So this is what it looks like
 at the far eastern edge
 of the world...

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese:
アラブやインドとはまた違う…
ここの建物もみんなエキゾチック
面白そうなところですね
records.current_English:
It's so different
 from the Arab lands and India. 
 Look at these buildings. What
 a fascinating place.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
ああ、すげえぜ
これぞ冒険ロマン、って感じだな
…お、何だ？
records.current_English:
Amazing, isn't it? Now 
 this feels like an adventure.
 ...Hey, what's that?

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese:
失礼
FOの
FA総帥と
お見受けする
records.current_English:
Excuse me. FO 
 is under your command, 
 isn't it, FA?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
うわー！　いかにも東洋の武将って
雰囲気のじいさんだな！
records.current_English:
Whoa! That old fellow looks every
 inch an Eastern commander!

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese: しっ！　…いきなり、失礼ですよ
records.current_English:
Shh! 
 You can't just say that to someone!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ええ、そうです。僕が
FI・FA
ですが
records.current_English:
Yes, that's right. 
 I'm FI FA.

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese: 覇者の証をお探しですな？
records.current_English: You seek the Proof?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.current_English: What?!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
あ…はい。そうですが…
ご存じだということは…
records.current_English:
Ah... Yes, we are. Does that mean
 you know something about it?

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese: それに関して、お話がありますのじゃ
records.current_English: I'd like to speak with you about it.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 分かりました。伺いましょう
records.current_English:
All right. 
 Let's hear what you have to say.

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese:
では
…マリア提督、こちらが
FA殿です
records.current_English: Admiral Maria, this is FA.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: おおー！　オリエンタルな美人！
records.current_English: Wow! An eastern beauty!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: いやはや、これはこれは…
records.current_English: Well, well...

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
…私はマリア・リー。彼は右腕のシエン
時間が惜しいの
用件だけに絞って話すわ
records.current_English:
I'm Maria Li. Xien is
 my right-hand man. Time is short,
 so I'll get to the point.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
あ…
は、はい
records.current_English: Ah... y-yes.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
おーい、FI
見とれるのは後にしろよ～！
records.current_English:
Hey, FI!
 You can stare later!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: わ、分かってるよ！
records.current_English: I-I know!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
照れるなって
きひひ
records.current_English: Aw, don't be embarrassed. Heh heh.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
…
話してもいいかしら？
records.current_English: ...May I speak now?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: は、はい。すみません
records.current_English: Y-yes. Sorry.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: 例の地図を解く鍵は私が持っている…
records.current_English:
I have the key to deciphering
 that map...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ！　あなたが…？
records.current_English: You have it...?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
そう。でも、私には必要のない代物よ
表立っては海禁策をとっている
この国ではね
records.current_English:
Yes. But I have no use for it. 
 There's an official ban
 on overseas voyages here,
 after all.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
…なるほど
でも、僕たちにはどうしても
必要なんです
records.current_English: I see. But we really do need it.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
そのようね
私の頼みを聞いてくれるなら
考えてもいいわ
records.current_English:
So it seems. 
 I might let you have it if you'll
 do something for me.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
本当に？　どうしたら
譲ってくださるんですか？
records.current_English: Really? What would it take?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
条件はひとつ
『倭寇のクルシマ海賊を滅ぼす』
それだけよ
records.current_English:
One condition. 
 Wipe out Kurushima's pirates.
 They're wako.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
？
『倭寇』って何だ？
records.current_English: What are wako?

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese:
主に、この東アジア海域で
海賊稼業に明け暮れておる
海の愚連隊じゃ
records.current_English:
Gangs of pirates. They spend 
 their days plundering, mostly here 
 in East Asian waters.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: そんなに怖い存在なんですか？
records.current_English: Are they really that dangerous?

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese:
怖い、というのは少し違う
“やっかい”、といったところかのう
records.current_English:
I'd call them a nuisance.
 The trouble is catching them.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
小回りのきく船で、沿岸の村を襲ったり
している。退治するにも、逃げ足が早い
から、追いかけきれなかったり
する場合が多いわ
records.current_English:
They hit coastal villages
 in nimble ships. When
 we go after them, they get away
 before we can catch them.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: 船足の速い艦船が必要かな…
records.current_English: We may need fast ships...

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese:
敵は小型船ばかりではない
最近は奴らも装備を充実させ
『いろんな型の船』
も持っとるようじゃ
records.current_English:
Small ships aren't all they have.
 They've improved their equipment 
 lately. Seems they've got
 all kinds of ships now.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
クルシマ家がいなくなったのを
確認したらこの『竹細工の組立絵図』を
渡すわ
records.current_English:
Once I've confirmed
 the Kurushima faction is gone, I'll
 give you the Bamboo Assembly Plan.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 絵図…ですか？
records.current_English: A plan...?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
東アジアの『証』を見つけるためには
どうしても必要な物よ
どう？　損な取引じゃないでしょう？
records.current_English:
You'll need it to find 
 the Proof of Conquest in East Asia.
 Not a bad deal, is it?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
分かりました
…やってみます
records.current_English: All right. We'll give it a try.

rows: from the Arab lands and India.
the Kurushima faction is gone, I'll
give you the Bamboo Assembly Plan.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: クルシマ家は滅んだね…
records.current_English: Kurushima is gone...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
これで、東アジアの覇者の証は
なんとかなるかもな
records.current_English:
Now we might have a shot at finding
 East Asia's Proof of Conquest.

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese: おお、クルシマがいなくなったか！
records.current_English: So Kurushima is gone!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: へへへ、まあな
records.current_English: Heh. Sure is.

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese:
あんたら、覇者の証を探して
いるのかい？
records.current_English: Looking for the Proof of Conquest?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ええ、そうなんです
ご存じなんですか？
records.current_English:
Yes, we are. Do you know anything
 about it?

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese:
杭州って街にいる
リー総帥が、何か知っているって話だぜ
records.current_English:
Word is Admiral Li knows something.
 You'll find her in Hangzhou.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ええ。あの…マリア・リー提督が
どこにいるかご存じですか？
records.current_English:
Yes. Um, do you know 
 where I can find Admiral Maria Li?

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese:
ああ、もちろんだ
いつもは杭州って街にいるぜ
records.current_English: Sure do. She's usually in Hangzhou.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: リー総帥って、有名なんですか？
records.current_English: Is Admiral Li famous around here?

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese:
有名も何も、ここいらじゃ
リー提督に逆らおうってなバカは
クルシマ海賊ぐらいだったからな
records.current_English:
Famous? Around here, 
 the Kurushima pirates were just
 about the only fools who'd dare
 cross Admiral Li.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
ふーん
まともにやりあわねえほうが
いいのか…
records.current_English:
Huh. Guess we'd better 
 not take her on directly...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
教えていただいて
ありがとうございました
よし、杭州に向かうとしよう！
records.current_English:
Thank you for your help. All right,
 let's head for Hangzhou!

rows: where I can find Admiral Maria Li?
about the only fools who'd dare

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
あなたをこの海域の覇者と
認めなければならないようね
これを受け取りなさい
records.current_English:
It seems I'll have to recognize
 you as the strongest power 
 in these waters. Here, take this.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
リー提督…
ありがとう
records.current_English: Admiral... thanks.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
しかたがないわ
あなたが覇者にふさわしいかどうか
この地で見届けることにするから
records.current_English:
I suppose I have little choice.
 I'll stay here and see 
 whether you're worthy of it.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: あなたは…？
records.current_English: And you...?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
誰だっていいわ
忘れてもらってけっこうよ
records.current_English:
Who I am doesn't matter. 
 You can forget about me.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: ご苦労だったわね
records.current_English: Well done.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: マリアさん！　…っと、リー提督！
records.current_English: Maria! Ah... Admiral Li!

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese:
うむ。提督はここで
待っておられたのじゃ
では…
records.current_English:
Indeed. The admiral
 has been waiting here. Now then...

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: さ、約束の絵図よ
records.current_English: Here. The plan I promised you.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
FIくん…
だったわね。他の海域に行っても
気を抜かないことね
records.current_English:
FI, was it? 
 Keep your guard up 
 in other waters, too.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: あ、あ、ありがとうございましたっ！！
records.current_English: Th-thank you very much!!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: へへっ、照れまくってやがんの
records.current_English: Heh. Look at you blush.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
も、もう！！
クラウ！　出発だよっ！！
records.current_English: E-enough! Clau, we're leaving!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
くくくっ
へいへい。行きやしょう、提督！
records.current_English:
Heh heh. Aye, aye, Admiral.
 Let's go!

rows: has been waiting here. Now then...
